title: EvalYaks: Instruction Tuning Datasets and LoRA Fine-tuned Models for Automated Scoring of CEFR B2 Speaking Assessment Transcripts
reasoning: The paper focuses on the automated evaluation and scoring of English language proficiency based on the CEFR framework. It evaluates linguistic criteria such as grammar, vocabulary, and discourse management, and does not involve the assessment of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
